kind: receipt-walks (NOT an exam; canon: receipts ≠ effect sizes)

instrument.flipOracleReusedFrom: scripts/probes/in-t0-snapshot-law.ts §3 — the shipped choosePerceivedPassTarget priced twice at one carrier moment. ⭐ CHANGED FROM IN-T0: the degraded side is built from the REAL `match.inSnapshotStore` book, not from a probe mirror, because IN-T0's law is armed on BOTH arms here.
instrument.flipOracleLimits: the oracle is the PERCEIVED-CHOICE chooser, not decideCarrier's full ladder; and it is read at EVERY carrier tick (a superset of his decision ticks), so the flip share is a LOWER BOUND. Its denominator MOVES between arms because the arms are different worlds — disclosed per face.
instrument.timerNote: only the `m.step(DT)` calls are inside the wall timer; the oracle runs outside it on both arms.

world.doors: a4MatchFlags(9) + bkFacingLaw + bkContactLaw + inSnapshotLaw@F2 (the world-9 stack plus IN-T0's law, armed on BOTH arms — the matched estimand)
world.armDifference: inLookAct only; dfAssignPersist, dfSurface and the banked o2Look seam are SHUT on all arms

statsNote: the CIs are bootstrap resamples of the WALKED seeds, not a registry-consuming statistic (the IN-T0 / DF-T2 precedent). The next stats base remains >= 115,200.

anchoredExtraction.ageCapNote: the FULL REVERSAL: ceil(PI / (TURN_RATE * DT)) — the widest turn the shipped form can charge for (BK-T0 §LAW: "theta <= PI => turnTicks <= 29, the full reversal of record"). It is the ceiling on what a stale memory may be worth, and it is the SAME algebra as the cost, so the two sides cannot drift apart.

faces.unit: share of the carrier chooser's other-body reads served from the private book
faces.what: IN-T0 §R1's face, re-measured: how much of what the man on the ball prices is remembered rather than seen
faces.denNote: denominator = other-body resolutions inside built views (the reader himself and sent-off bodies are excluded by construction)

faces.unit: share of the carrier chooser's other-body reads refreshed to truth
faces.what: the refresh half of IN-T0's law (the complement, cold starts aside)

faces.unit: share of the carrier chooser's other-body reads served by the cold-start rule
faces.what: how much of the receipt is the born-knowing-the-lineup seeding

faces.unit: TICKS (sim ticks; 1 tick = DT sim-seconds)
faces.what: ⭐ THE HEADLINE: MEAN STALENESS AGE — the size of the hole IN-T1 exists to fill (IN-T0 §R1 measured 1,782.59 ticks at F2 on its own block)
faces.denNote: denominator = STALE reads only (a fresh read has no age) — it MOVES between arms, and is published per arm for exactly that reason

faces.unit: sim-seconds (the dual axis; clock honesty)
faces.what: ⭐ the same age on the sim clock — IN-T0 §R1's 29.71 sim-seconds is the number this arm pair is measured against

faces.unit: share of decisions at which a look was ELECTED and taken
faces.what: ⭐ THE USAGE RECEIPT. Contract §4 makes an ALL-SCANNING world a FAILURE mode, so this face is read in BOTH directions: > 0 (the seam is used) and < 1 (the cost declines looks)

faces.unit: share of decisions at which the election ran and DECLINED

buyBack.inT0Note: IN-T0 §R1, armed-F2, block 12,511,000-999 — a DIFFERENT seed draw of the SAME estimand as this battery's `lookShut` arm. Quoted as the mandate, never as this battery's own baseline: the `lookShut` value below is the baseline of record here.

denominatorMoved.note: canon "moving denominators": the mean-age denominator is STALE READS, which the look changes on purpose. Both numerators and both denominators are published so the face can be re-derived either way.

perf.budgetNote: THE BUDGET IS A BUDGET, NOT A SELF-MEASURED SHARE (the DF-C0 anchor idiom): 20 % of the anchor's OWN decide-phase cost, because this seam lives entirely inside the decide phase. ⭐ UNLIKE IN-T0, the flip oracle runs OUTSIDE the step timer on BOTH arms, so the shut-vs-armed delta below is a clean arm-to-arm wall comparison of the engine step itself. It is still a WALL measurement on a shared machine, never a profiler attribution.
perf.bookkeepingRecordsCeilingNote: the STRUCTURAL ceiling: every body on the pitch as a reader × every other body. The MEASURED footprint is `storeEntriesAtFullTime`.
perf.windowRecordsCeilingNote: the look windows are per-body, so at most one per body on the pitch (unlike the O2 seam's single global window).
